chunks: Whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn ʿImrān al-ʿIjlī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his uncle Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Qāsim, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muḥammad ibn ʿImrān al-ʿIjlī.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating the author’s route of narration
key_terms.عَنْ عَمِّهِ: From his uncle; a relational link within the sanad
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: A major transmitter appearing in the chain
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ الْعِجْلِيِّ: The narrator to whom this transmission chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn ʿImrān al-ʿIjlī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a sanad clarification in which the author identifies his transmission route to Muḥammad ibn ʿImrān al-ʿIjlī. Its significance lies in documenting the hadith chain and preserving the source lineage for narrations in the book.
